--- Record-App/scripts/release.sh	
+++ Record-App/scripts/release.sh	
@@ -1,162 +1,171 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 # release.sh — Build a signed release DMG for THE RECORD.
 # Usage: bash scripts/release.sh [--skip-build] [--open] [--clean]
 set -euo pipefail
 
 APP_NAME="THE RECORD"
 BINARY_NAME="TheRecord"
 BUNDLE_ID="app.the-record"
 VERSION="0.9.0"
 REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
 BUILD_SHA=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD)
 BUILD_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/.build/arm64-apple-macosx/release"
 APP_BUNDLE="$BUILD_DIR/$BINARY_NAME.app"
 DMG_NAME="TheRecord-$VERSION-$BUILD_SHA.dmg"
 DMG_PATH="$BUILD_DIR/$DMG_NAME"
 SKIP_BUILD=false
 OPEN_AFTER=false
 CLEAN_BUILD=false
 
 for arg in "$@"; do
     case "$arg" in
         --skip-build) SKIP_BUILD=true ;;
         --open)       OPEN_AFTER=true ;;
         --clean)      CLEAN_BUILD=true ;;
     esac
 done
 
 echo "=== THE RECORD Release $VERSION ($BUILD_SHA) ==="
 
 # 1. Compile
 if [ "$SKIP_BUILD" = true ]; then
     echo "[1/5] Skipping compile (--skip-build)"
 else
     if [ "$CLEAN_BUILD" = true ]; then
         echo "[1/5] Cleaning build artifacts..."
         swift package --package-path "$REPO_ROOT" clean
     fi
     echo "[1/5] Compiling release build..."
     swift build -c release --product TheRecord --package-path "$REPO_ROOT"
 fi
 
 BINARY="$BUILD_DIR/$BINARY_NAME"
 if [ ! -f "$BINARY" ]; then
     echo "ERROR: Binary not found at $BINARY — run without --skip-build"
     exit 1
 fi
 
 # 2. Assemble .app bundle
 echo "[2/5] Assembling app bundle..."
 rm -rf "$APP_BUNDLE"
 mkdir -p "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS"
 mkdir -p "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Resources"
 mkdir -p "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Frameworks"
 cp "$BINARY" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS/$BINARY_NAME"
 
 # Embed prebuilt frameworks that ship via @rpath (not in /System/Library)
 CMLX_FW="$BUILD_DIR/Cmlx.framework"
 if [ -d "$CMLX_FW" ]; then
     cp -R "$CMLX_FW" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Frameworks/"
     install_name_tool -add_rpath @executable_path/../Frameworks "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS/$BINARY_NAME"
     echo "    Embedded Cmlx.framework"
 else
     echo "    WARNING: Cmlx.framework not found at $CMLX_FW — run without --skip-build"
 fi
 
+# Copy SwiftPM resource bundles (.bundle dirs) into Resources/
+BUNDLE_COUNT=0
+for bundle in "$BUILD_DIR"/*.bundle; do
+    [ -d "$bundle" ] || continue
+    cp -R "$bundle" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Resources/"
+    BUNDLE_COUNT=$((BUNDLE_COUNT + 1))
+done
+echo "    Embedded $BUNDLE_COUNT resource bundle(s)"
+
 PLIST_SRC="$REPO_ROOT/Record-App/Sources/TheRecord/Info.plist"
 if [ -f "$PLIST_SRC" ]; then
     cp "$PLIST_SRC" "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Info.plist"
 else
 cat > "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Info.plist" << PLIST
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
 <plist version="1.0">
 <dict>
     <key>CFBundleDevelopmentRegion</key><string>en</string>
     <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>$BINARY_NAME</string>
     <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>$BUNDLE_ID</string>
     <key>CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion</key><string>6.0</string>
     <key>CFBundleName</key><string>THE RECORD</string>
     <key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>THE RECORD</string>
     <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
     <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>$VERSION</string>
     <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>$BUILD_SHA</string>
     <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>15.0</string>
     <key>NSPrincipalClass</key><string>NSApplication</string>
     <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
     <key>NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription</key>
     <string>THE RECORD reads your calendar to detect upcoming meetings and show attendee context.</string>
     <key>NSMicrophoneUsageDescription</key>
     <string>THE RECORD records meeting audio for transcription.</string>
     <key>NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription</key>
     <string>THE RECORD captures meeting audio for transcription.</string>
 </dict>
 </plist>
 PLIST
 fi
 
 # 3. Codesign
 echo "[3/5] Codesigning..."
 mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/tmp"
 ENTITLEMENTS="$BUILD_DIR/tmp/therecord-entitlements.plist"
 cat > "$ENTITLEMENTS" << 'ENT'
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
 <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
 <plist version="1.0">
 <dict>
     <key>com.apple.security.app-sandbox</key><false/>
     <key>com.apple.security.personal-information.calendars</key><true/>
     <key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key><true/>
     <key>com.apple.security.device.camera</key><true/>
 </dict>
 </plist>
 ENT
 
 SIGN_IDENTITY="TheRecord Dev"
 if security find-identity -v -p codesigning 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$SIGN_IDENTITY"; then
     SIGN_FLAG="$SIGN_IDENTITY"
 else
     SIGN_FLAG="-"
     echo "    Signing ad-hoc (no '$SIGN_IDENTITY' identity found)"
 fi
 # Sign inner frameworks first (--deep chokes on prebuilt xcframeworks)
 find "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Frameworks" -name "*.framework" -maxdepth 1 | while read -r fw; do
     codesign --force --sign "$SIGN_FLAG" "$fw" 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" || true
 done
 codesign --force --sign "$SIGN_FLAG" --entitlements "$ENTITLEMENTS" "$APP_BUNDLE"
 echo "    Signed: $SIGN_FLAG"
 rm -f "$ENTITLEMENTS"
 
 # 4. Verify
 echo "[4/5] Verifying..."
 codesign --verify --verbose "$APP_BUNDLE" 2>&1 || echo "    Warning: verification issue (expected for ad-hoc)"
 
 # 5. Create DMG
 echo "[5/5] Creating DMG..."
 rm -f "$DMG_PATH"
 DMG_TMP="$BUILD_DIR/tmp/dmg-staging"
 rm -rf "$DMG_TMP"
 mkdir -p "$DMG_TMP"
 cp -R "$APP_BUNDLE" "$DMG_TMP/"
 ln -s /Applications "$DMG_TMP/Applications"
 hdiutil create -volname "THE RECORD" -srcfolder "$DMG_TMP" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -2
 rm -rf "$DMG_TMP"
 
 # Cleanup: keep only the 5 most recent DMGs
 OLD_DMGS=$(ls -t "$BUILD_DIR"/TheRecord-*.dmg 2>/dev/null | tail -n +6)
 if [ -n "$OLD_DMGS" ]; then
     echo "Cleaning up old DMGs..."
     echo "$OLD_DMGS" | xargs rm -f
 fi
 
 echo ""
 echo "=== Done ==="
 echo "App:  $APP_BUNDLE"
 echo "DMG:  $DMG_PATH"
 echo "Size: $(du -sh "$DMG_PATH" | cut -f1)"
 echo ""
 echo "Install: open $DMG_PATH"
 
 if [ "$OPEN_AFTER" = true ]; then
     open "$DMG_PATH"
 fi

102: - **Impact:** Zero-touch meeting recording. User never forgets to hit record.
103: - **Logic:** Mic/camera activates → 3s debounce → auto-start. Deactivates → 10s debounce (handles mute/unmute) → auto-stop + transcribe.
104: - **Optional refinement:** Check if foreground app is Zoom/Teams/Meet/FaceTime before auto-starting (NSWorkspace).
105: - **Scope:** ~50 line Infrastructure actor + settings toggle in Presentation
106: - **Target:** Epic 5 (UI polish) — needs a settings toggle so users opt in

108: ### TRIAGE-015: Dual-track recording — separate mic from system audio
109: - **What:** Currently capture is single-track (ScreenCaptureKit system audio only). For proper diarization and echo cancellation, need dual-track: system audio (remote speakers) + mic audio (local user). Mic track → "You", system track → diarize for remote speakers.

111: - **Architecture:** Add `AudioTrack` enum (.system, .microphone) to Domain. Update `AudioCaptureEngine` to support multi-track. AVAudioEngine for mic capture alongside ScreenCaptureKit for system.
112: - **Echo cancellation:** Core Audio AEC handles mic echo subtraction automatically for built-in speakers. External speaker setups may need post-processing.
113: - **Target:** Epic 5 or Epic 7 (needed before streaming diarization is useful)
114: 
115: ### TRIAGE-014: Live translation — real-time multilingual subtitles
116: - **What:** Transcribe in language A, translate to language B, display as live subtitles. Three viable approaches: Whisper built-in translate (English-only output), Parakeet + local LLM, or Parakeet + Apple Translation framework (macOS 15+, ~50 language pairs, on-device).
117: - **Impact:** Killer differentiator. MacParakeet doesn't have this. Turns THE RECORD from "meeting transcriber" into "real-time interpreter."
118: - **Recommended approach:** Apple `Translation` framework — purpose-built, on-device, ~50-100ms per segment, no API key, no extra model download.
119: - **Architecture:** New `TranslationEngine: Sendable` protocol (Domain), `AppleTranslationPlugin` actor (Infrastructure), `LiveTranslateUseCase` actor (Business). Fully additive — zero changes to existing code.
120: - **Latency budget:** ~20ms transcription (Parakeet) + ~100ms translation (Apple) = ~120ms total. Fast enough for live subtitles.
121: - **Dependencies:** macOS 15+ (already our minimum), `import Translation`
122: - **Target:** Epic 7+ (after streaming transcription is built)
123: 
124: ### TRIAGE-013: Inference telemetry for model selection decisions
125: - **What:** Add lightweight performance telemetry to transcription pipeline: encoder time, decoder time, samples/second, real-time factor, peak memory, compute unit used. Log locally — no cloud.
126: - **Impact:** Without real numbers, model decisions (distil-large-v3 vs Parakeet vs turbo) are guesswork. ANE benchmarks show 19 TFLOPS FP16 real peak — we need to know what fraction we're using.
127: - **Scope:** Instrument `WhisperKitPlugin.transcribe()`. Store in local structured log. Surface via debug view or CLI.
128: - **Metrics:** encoder duration (ms), decoder duration (ms), total inference, audio duration, RTF, model ID, compute unit, sample count
129: - **Target:** Epic 3.5 (apples-to-apples comparison data for Parakeet evaluation)

- **Fix:** Add eager model load on app launch (or lazy load on first transcribe). TASK-017 will address this.
- **Target:** Epic 3 TASK-017 (this branch)

## P1 — Correctness Issues

### TRIAGE-004: UI allows duplicate start/stop during in-flight operations
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/Presentation/ViewModels/MenuBarViewModel.swift`, `MenuBarPopover.swift`
- **What:** Button switches on `isRecording` only. During `start()` await, `isRecording` is still false — fast clicks enqueue duplicate operations.
- **Fix:** Add `isStarting`/`isStopping` flags, disable buttons during in-flight ops.
- **Target:** Epic 5 (Menu Bar UI polish)

### TRIAGE-005: Storage list silently drops corrupt metadata
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/Infrastructure/Storage/FileSystemStorageActor.swift:124`
- **What:** `listRecordings()` catches decode failures per-entry, logs warning, returns partial list.
- **Impact:** User sees incomplete history with no indication entries were dropped.
- **Fix:** Design decision — either add `listRecordingsStrict()` or surface count of dropped entries. Low urgency.
- **Target:** Epic 2 (Storage)

## P2 — Code Quality

### TRIAGE-006: 2x @unchecked Sendable
- **Files:** `AudioBufferStorage`, `AudioStreamBridge`
- **What:** Both use `@unchecked Sendable`. AudioBufferStorage is immutable (justified). AudioStreamBridge is NSObject+SCStreamOutput (arguably unavoidable).
- **Fix:** Document AudioStreamBridge as accepted exception. Consider if there's a way to avoid it.
- **Target:** Epic 1.5 or Epic 5

### TRIAGE-007: Estimated sampleCount from wall-clock time
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/Infrastructure/Audio/SystemAudioCaptureActor.swift`
- **What:** `sampleCount` computed from duration × sampleRate instead of actual buffer count.
- **Fix:** Accumulate actual sample count from buffers.
- **Target:** Epic 1.5

### TRIAGE-008: Doc comment says {id}-metadata.json but code writes {id}.json
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/Infrastructure/Storage/FileSystemStorageActor.swift`
- **What:** Comment/code mismatch on metadata filename.
- **Fix:** Align comment to code (or vice versa).
- **Target:** Epic 2

### TRIAGE-009: O(n) recursive enumeration for single-record lookup
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/Infrastructure/Storage/FileSystemStorageActor.swift`
- **What:** `getRecording(id:)` enumerates all recordings to find one by ID.
- **Fix:** Add ID→path index or direct path construction.
- **Target:** Epic 2

### TRIAGE-010: DI factory creates fresh instances per call
- **File:** `Sources/THE RECORD/THE RECORDApp.swift`
- **What:** `makeViewModel()` creates new instances of everything on each call. Fine today, fragile if called more than once.
- **Fix:** Lazy singletons or explicit lifecycle. Low urgency — only called once at launch.
- **Target:** Epic 5

### TRIAGE-011: (any Error)? in error enums isn't guaranteed Sendable
- **Files:** `TranscriptionError`, `AudioError`
- **What:** `underlying: Error?` fields hold existential errors that may not be Sendable.
- **Fix:** Consider `underlying: (any Error & Sendable)?` or document the risk.
- **Target:** Future (Swift evolution may address this)

## P0 — Strategic Opportunity

### TRIAGE-012: Add Parakeet TDT via FluidAudio as TranscriptionEngine
- **What:** MacParakeet ships Parakeet TDT 0.6B-v3 via [FluidAudio](https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio) CoreML. 155x realtime, ~2.5% WER, 25 languages, ~66MB working memory. Our `TranscriptionEngine` protocol makes this a drop-in.
- **Impact:** 25x speed improvement over distil-large-v3. One-pass becomes fast enough that two-pass is optional, not required. Speaker labels come built-in (FluidAudio includes diarization), which could shortcut Epic 4.
- **Scope:** New `ParakeetPlugin: TranscriptionEngine` actor in Infrastructure. ~1 task. Zero changes to Domain, Business, or Presentation.
- **Dependencies:** `FluidAudio` SPM package (`.upToNextMinor(from: "0.14.1")`). Apple Silicon only. macOS 14+.
- **Risk:** FluidAudio model download is ~6GB on first launch. Need download progress (already built — TASK-012).
- **Decision:** Does Parakeet replace WhisperKit as default, or sit alongside as a selectable engine? MacParakeet uses Parakeet as default + WhisperKit fallback for CJK languages.
- **Target:** Epic 3.5 (single-task epic) or fold into Epic 4 if diarization comes with it

### TRIAGE-017: Calendar integration — meeting context backbone
- **What:** Read Calendar.app events (EventKit) to provide meeting identity, participant lists, recurring series history, and auto-labeling. Calendar is not just detection — it's the pre-meeting brief, the folder structure, and the speaker enrollment source.
- **Impact:** Transforms every meeting from cold start to warm continuation. Recurring meetings become threaded folders with commitment tracking across weeks.
- **Feeds into:** Pre-meeting briefs (I2), commitment tracker (I4), speaker enrollment (Epic 4.5), auto-labeling transcripts, meeting series folders
- **Architecture:** New `CalendarEngine` protocol (Domain), `EventKitPlugin` actor (Infrastructure), integrates with THE RECORDEngine (Epic 8)
- **Permissions:** EventKit requires calendar access permission — single prompt on first use
- **Target:** Epic 8 (THE RECORD Engine) — the calendar IS the context source for meetings

### TRIAGE-016: Auto-start recording on mic/camera activation
- **What:** Detect when the mic or camera activates (the orange/green dot) and auto-start recording. Auto-stop when they deactivate. Uses `AVCaptureDevice.isInUseByAnotherApplication` KVO — no calendar API or extra permissions needed.
- **Impact:** Zero-touch meeting recording. User never forgets to hit record.
- **Logic:** Mic/camera activates → 3s debounce → auto-start. Deactivates → 10s debounce (handles mute/unmute) → auto-stop + transcribe.
- **Optional refinement:** Check if foreground app is Zoom/Teams/Meet/FaceTime before auto-starting (NSWorkspace).
- **Scope:** ~50 line Infrastructure actor + settings toggle in Presentation
- **Target:** Epic 5 (UI polish) — needs a settings toggle so users opt in

### TRIAGE-015: Dual-track recording — separate mic from system audio
- **What:** Currently capture is single-track (ScreenCaptureKit system audio only). For proper diarization and echo cancellation, need dual-track: system audio (remote speakers) + mic audio (local user). Mic track → "You", system track → diarize for remote speakers.
- **Impact:** Without dual-track, the diarizer can't reliably distinguish local user from remote participants. Also, the mic currently isn't captured at all — only system audio.
- **Architecture:** Add `AudioTrack` enum (.system, .microphone) to Domain. Update `AudioCaptureEngine` to support multi-track. AVAudioEngine for mic capture alongside ScreenCaptureKit for system.
- **Echo cancellation:** Core Audio AEC handles mic echo subtraction automatically for built-in speakers. External speaker setups may need post-processing.
- **Target:** Epic 5 or Epic 7 (needed before streaming diarization is useful)

### TRIAGE-014: Live translation — real-time multilingual subtitles
- **What:** Transcribe in language A, translate to language B, display as live subtitles. Three viable approaches: Whisper built-in translate (English-only output), Parakeet + local LLM, or Parakeet + Apple Translation framework (macOS 15+, ~50 language pairs, on-device).
- **Impact:** Killer differentiator. MacParakeet doesn't have this. Turns THE RECORD from "meeting transcriber" into "real-time interpreter."
- **Recommended approach:** Apple `Translation` framework — purpose-built, on-device, ~50-100ms per segment, no API key, no extra model download.
- **Architecture:** New `TranslationEngine: Sendable` protocol (Domain), `AppleTranslationPlugin` actor (Infrastructure), `LiveTranslateUseCase` actor (Business). Fully additive — zero changes to existing code.
- **Latency budget:** ~20ms transcription (Parakeet) + ~100ms translation (Apple) = ~120ms total. Fast enough for live subtitles.
- **Dependencies:** macOS 15+ (already our minimum), `import Translation`
- **Target:** Epic 7+ (after streaming transcription is built)

### TRIAGE-013: Inference telemetry for model selection decisions
- **What:** Add lightweight performance telemetry to transcription pipeline: encoder time, decoder time, samples/second, real-time factor, peak memory, compute unit used. Log locally — no cloud.
- **Impact:** Without real numbers, model decisions (distil-large-v3 vs Parakeet vs turbo) are guesswork. ANE benchmarks show 19 TFLOPS FP16 real peak — we need to know what fraction we're using.
- **Scope:** Instrument `WhisperKitPlugin.transcribe()`. Store in local structured log. Surface via debug view or CLI.
- **Metrics:** encoder duration (ms), decoder duration (ms), total inference, audio duration, RTF, model ID, compute unit, sample count
- **Target:** Epic 3.5 (apples-to-apples comparison data for Parakeet evaluation)

+public extension GRDBStorageActor {
+    func recordTelemetry(_ entries: [InferenceMetrics]) throws {
+        guard !entries.isEmpty else { return }
+        do {
+            try dbPool.write { db in
+                for entry in entries {
+                    let id = "\(entry.modelId.rawValue)-\(entry.timestamp.timeIntervalSince1970)"
+                    let memMB = entry.processMetrics.map { Int64($0.processMemoryUsage / 1_048_576) }
+                    let gpuMB = entry.processMetrics.map { Int64($0.processMlxMemoryUsage / 1_048_576) }
+                    try db.execute(sql: GRDBSQL.insertTelemetry, arguments: [
+                        id,
+                        entry.timestamp.ISO8601Format(),
+                        entry.modelId.rawValue,
+                        entry.audioDuration,
+                        entry.inferenceDuration,
+                        entry.realTimeFactor,
+                        entry.confidence,
+                        entry.sampleCount,
+                        entry.computeUnit.rawValue,
+                        entry.processMetrics?.processCpuUtilization,
+                        memMB,
+                        gpuMB,
+                        entry.processMetrics.map { $0.processPageFaults },
+                        entry.environmentMetrics?.osVersion,
+                        entry.environmentMetrics?.cpuBrandString,
+                        entry.environmentMetrics.map { $0.physicalMemoryMB },
+                        entry.environmentMetrics?.thermalState,
+                        entry.environmentMetrics.flatMap { $0.isPluggedIn },
+                        entry.environmentMetrics.map { $0.batteryStartPercentage },
+                    ])
+                }
+            }

### Architecture Decisions

1. **Keep Typography/Metrics/DesignTokens as-is** — They're already well-designed editorial constants. The `AppTheme` protocol wraps them rather than replacing them.

2. **Environment + Notification hybrid** — Keep the `Notification.Name.themeChanged` system for cross-process notification delivery (existing `THE RECORDApp.swift` listens to it). Add `@Environment(\.theme)` for view-level reactivity.

3. **Backward compatibility** — `Color.ink`, `Typography.masthead`, `Metrics.unit` remain as static enums. The `AppTheme` protocol provides instance-based access for skinning. Old code keeps working; new code uses `.theme`.

4. **JSON schema validation** — Use a lightweight manual decoder rather than pulling in a JSON schema library. The schema is small enough to validate inline.

5. **Theme file location** — `~/Library/Application Support/com.the-record/themes/` — consistent with existing app data location.
